Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Tuerong

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Tuerong. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Larger blocks, sheds and treed sites are part of the job in Tuerong, and we are used to roofs that need more than a quick once-over. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Tuerong: What We Commonly See

Tuerong is rural country between Moorooduc and the bay, an area of vineyards, horse properties and acreage homes set back among paddocks and gum trees. The homes here are often larger and almost always come with a shed, stable or machinery building alongside the house. Set inland, the wear comes more from harsh summer UV, gum-leaf litter and wind across open country than from salt.

The jobs we are called out for most in Tuerong are refixing cracked ridge capping, clearing and replacing leaf-filled gutters and valleys, and re-roofing or re-sheeting larger home and shed roofs that have faded and worn.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Tuerong

On larger blocks a roof is a bigger investment, and replacing one properly pays off for decades. We re-roof Tuerong homes, sheds and outbuildings in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and low maintenance, and handles heat, wind and heavy leaf litter well.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Tuerong

Larger roofs and treed blocks put a lot of water and debris through the gutters. Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes, and can connect rainwater tanks and stormwater so the water ends up where it should.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Tuerong

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Tuerong Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Tuerong Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Browse the COLORBOND® colour chart to start picturing your new roof.

Tuerong Roofing FAQs

Do you work on sheds and outbuildings as well as the house?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, garages, stables and other outbuildings in metal, as well as the main house.

Can you fix gutters that fill with leaves and bark?

Yes. We replace overflowing gutters and valleys, and can fit systems that cope better with heavy leaf litter on treed blocks.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
